items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So little Herman Henderson, he showed me how to get them three chords, the foundation, and how to sing

ctx.x: Lived right around a couple of blocks from me.

Now, across the street from me is Don Albert, who is going to school taking clarinet lessons. And on the next block is Herman Henderson. He's taking clarinet lessons. And all around you, every day you could hear horns. You'd pass the street and listen to some kid practicing a horn, practicing the clarinet, or somebody playing the piano. It was just music, music, music, music, music, music, music. No football, no basketball, no nothin'. It was nothing else but music. So little Herman Henderson, he showed me how to…

Charlie Costain(?), I meet him. He was another little kid. He played a little ukelele. And I go to his house, and he's in there, his mother's hitting him on the wrist(?) because he wasn't playing the piano right. If he was playing the piano right, what ...(? )...(? )...
